Benfica (Luanda)|Benfica Luanda]] (15 May 2011)}} | highest scoring = [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro Atlético]] 7–0 [[Futebol Clube Onze Bravos do Maquis|Bravos Maquis]] | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 240 | total goals = 532 | prevseason = [[2010 Girabola|2010]] | nextseason = [[2012 Girabola|2012]] }} The '''2011 [[Girabola]]''' was the 33rd season of top-tier football in [[Angola]]. The season ran from 12 March to 6 November 2011. [[G.D. Interclube|Interclube]] were the defending champions, having won their 2nd Angolan championship in 2010. 16 teams were involved in the league and the bottom three teams were relegated to the 2012 [[Gira Angola]].{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2011.html |title=Angola 2011 |date=May 6, 2011 |access-date=May 20, 2011 |author=King, Ian}} [[Clube Recreativo Desportivo do Libolo|Recreativo Libolo]] were crowned champions, while [[F.C. Cabinda|FC Cabinda]], [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]] and [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica Lobito]] were relegated.{{cite web |url=http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=467 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120331203701/http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=467 |url-status=dead |archive-date=March 31, 2012 |title=Recreativo do Libolo empata na consagração |date=September 6, 2011 |publisher=Federação Angolana de Futebol }} [[Love (footballer)|Love Cabungula]] of [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro Luanda]] finished as top scorer with 20 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=468 |title=Love sagra-se melhor "artilheiro" pela terceira vez |date=September 6, 2011 |publisher=Federação Angolana de Futebol |access-date=2011-11-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120122135633/http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=468 |archive-date=2012-01-22 |url-status=dead }} Angola was informed by [[Confederation of African Football|CAF]] that it will have only 2 teams (one team in each competition) competing in the 2012 CAF club competitions, according to the latest [[CAF 5-year ranking]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/motix/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2011/6/30/CAF-diminui-participacao-angolana-nas-afrotacas,90257fc2-a11f-4ded-84b4-dff35c8f9c78.html |title=CAF diminui participação angolana nas afrotaças(portuguese) |access-date=2011-11-11 |archive-date=2020-03-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200312020116/http://www.angop.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2011/6/30/CAF-diminui-participacao-angolana-nas-afrotacas,90257fc2-a11f-4ded-84b4-dff35c8f9c78.html |url-status=dead }} The Girabola champion will play in the [[2012 CAF Champions League]]. ==Teams== [[C.D. Huíla]], [[Sporting Clube Petróleos de Cabinda|SC Petróleos de Cabinda]], and [[S.L. Benfica (Lubango)|Sport Lubango e Benfica]] were directly relegated to the Gira Angola after finishing 12th, 13th and 14th respectively in the previous year's standings. They were replaced by First Division Série A champions [[Progresso Associação do Sambizanga|Progresso]], Série B champions [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]], and [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica Lobito]], winners of the promotion play-off between Série A and B runners-up. ==Changes from 2010 season== '''Relegated:''' [[C.D.
